origin.thread_label: Task 2 R1 native Compass funding-time timestamp semantics / 2026-10-14

title: Fix OKX funding settlement-time provenance mislabeled as quote observed_at (research-only metadata)
objective: Repair ONLY the provenance metadata mapping for BTC/ETH OKX funding observations in native Compass evidence_snapshot. In existing scripts/data_ping/native_handlekompas.py, live funding_time is a scheduled settlement epoch in milliseconds but currently populates observed_at, creating misleading future-observed timestamps in six of nine original v3 forecast source chains. Keep funding_rate/value, health, scoring, eligibility decision, forecast and action policy unchanged. Preserve funding settlement epoch as explicit separate settlement-time metadata if compatible with existing schema; otherwise propose a versioned backward-compatible additive note and remain NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE. Derive quote observed/retrieved clock only from an independently bound pre-existing upstream source capture timestamp/receipt when available; never manufacture capture/publication time from settlement, current wall-clock, Git commit date or retrospective API. Missing original quote capture clock remains UNKNOWN, not automatically fresh/predictive or a reason to rewrite historical outcomes. Add deterministic positive/negative regression tests, preserve original 2026-10-12/13 issued data. Do not self-promote historical PIT or change production trade signals. If contract semantics would change downstream model decisions, stop and escalate to existing framework owner instead of quietly altering gates.
allowed_change_scope: Donh91/Investering-Framework-Archive-v1:04_MARKET_LEARNING/handlekompas/research/*TASK2_R1* only for append-only source-valued-free verification receipt

evidence.summary: At a pinned original Git head, 12 funding field clocks in six of nine native-v3 issued forecasts show observed_at after issue because observed_at is OKX funding_time (scheduled settlement) rather than original quote capture.
Current exact main blob d00d38bed517861fa2487dce42d330bf05812f6d, source builder _feature('btc_funding'/'eth_funding', ... funding_time observed_at), independently inspected.
Current exact main blob db67b1a429794c0b022f2f06db1e36d58b8e2b50 distinguishes fundingRate from fundingTime; no quote first-known proof is exported by that field.
Full 11-v3 original issuance population, nine outcomes and two outcome-absent attempts; share identical source/clock ambiguity.
Vendor API documentation for fundingTime = next funding settlement; historical quote as-of must be independently anchored.
Merged historical source-clock audit; source and output remain immutable.

reproduction: At current main, inspect scripts/data_ping/native_handlekompas.py: _feature('btc_funding'/'eth_funding') passes derivative_live[BTC/ETH-USDT-SWAP].funding.funding_time as observed_at. The collector constructs funding_time=int(row['fundingTime']). In a deterministic fixture with issue timestamp 2026-10-12T23:24:24Z and funding settlement time after issue, observe evidence_snapshot.selected_features.btc_funding/eth_funding.observed_at erroneously set to future epoch despite the original auto-state packet existing preissue. The audit receipt freezes 12 affected original labels / nine issued-v3 12h-outcome cases, without claiming actual lookahead.

positive: Unit fixture: current quote rate captured before issuance and settlement after issuance; output preserves funding value and all original action/score/health eligibility fields, but gives distinct capture-as-of and settlement timestamps; no future settlement is misrepresented as observed_at.
Fixture: settlement already occurred and authentic quote/capture time precedes issued_at; preserve typed settlement metadata and original economic values, and no spurious forward timestamp.
Backwards-compatible schema: unchanged original source packet/forecast blobs; deterministic repeat output hash for same input; no new external API calls, duplicate workflow or private data.
Run relevant existing tests/data_ping/test_official_daily_compass.py and new bounded regression tests; verify derived labels and no net change in original forecast/rule/action authority.
negative: Missing original quote/capture time: NEVER copy scheduled future funding_time into observed_at, NEVER synthesize today's UTC time or Git commit time as original provider publication, and NEVER silently mark verified PIT. Use unknown provenance/fail-closed classification without mutating trade signals.
Spoofed quote-capture timestamp after issue or future relative to packet generated_at must remain not R1 admissible; detection must fail a strict PIT eligibility fixture, not rewrite past data.
Milliseconds-vs-seconds test: scheduled fundingTime epoch in ms must not pass as actual observation-time in seconds or ISO publication time.
Conflicting time-zone or invalid capture schema yields explicit unknown provenance rather than a fabricated chronological guarantee.
No legacy v1/v2 original output overwritten, no market gates, model weights, threshold changes, canonical authority or portfolio output modified; tests fail on such changes.
